CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinate set), its presentation/representation (coordinate listing) and a separate origin/status field are all present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to content presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report names specific represented content (color-labeled coordinate sets) with explicit attribute labeling.

D.rationale: A separate origin/status entry is provided alongside the content coordinates, distinguishing identification from provenance/status.

O.rationale: The coordinate listings state how content is represented/presented in an organized spatial pattern for the named record/time.
